Stacked on #63296, #63307, #63393, #63523 and #63579 — the head branch carries those PRs' commits; only the last commit is new. ## Motivation A torch-profiler trace of the five-PR stack (campaign dsv41-pd-fusions-prof-002, 8xH200 PD decode, c16, MTP 3) also covers the DSpark draft graph: its FULL-cudagraph prologue spends ~105 us of in-graph GPU per decode step before the draft layers. Three items in it are removable work; this PR carries them, cutting ~35 us and 6 launches per step. ## One merged context_wkv_proj GEMM The context-KV precompute ran one `fused_wqa_wkv` GEMM ([T,5120]x[5120,1792]) per draft layer and discarded the q_lora half of each output — only the 512-wide WKV rows were consumed, so 1280 of 1792 output rows per layer were dead compute (~26 us across the three GEMMs). A merged `context_wkv_proj` ([T,5120]x[5120,1536]) now projects every layer's WKV in one GEMM, and `precompute_and_store_context_kv` slices the stacked output per layer. Weight loading duplicates each `mtp.{i}.attn.wkv` shard into the merged projection with the layer index as shard id, mirroring the DeepSeek V4 dspark implementation that already ships this pattern. The 512-wide output sections keep the fp8 block-quant shards 128-aligned, so quantization is unchanged. ## kv_norm folded into the KV rope/insert kernel The per-layer kv_norm RMSNorm ran as a separate kernel on the projected KV before the rope/quantize/insert op, with a copy in between for the strided slice. `fused_deepseek_v4_kv_rope_insert` now takes the norm weight and a row-strided KV view (plus the row stride), so the projection output slice is normalized, roped, quantized and inserted into the cache with no intermediate kernels — V4 still norms outside its dummy-q insert. The warp-shuffle reduction order differs from torch's, so the kernel test asserts against the fp8 code granularity (one code of slack on the NoPE half, 2 bf16 ULP after RoPE). ## 2D broadcast entry into draft layer 0 The draft entered layer 0 by repeating the 2D embedding to [24,20480] for the full `hc_attn_fn` matrix multiply, then summing the identical hc copies back. The target's entry layer already has the broadcast form: `hc_attn_fn_broadcast` ([24,5120]) applied to the 2D input, with the summed weight finalized once after load. The draft now uses the same path — `finalize_mhc_broadcast_weights` runs on the draft's `process_weights_after_loading`, since the draft loads outside the target's finalize. Mathematically identical: the column-block sum of identical copies, with the same RMS mean. ## Tests - `test_dsv41_context_wkv_weights_are_duplicated_by_draft_layer` — shard ids and storage identity of the duplicated WKV weights. - `test_dsv41_context_kv_uses_one_stacked_wkv_projection` — one projection call, per-layer slices inserted with their slot mappings. - `test_dsv41_draft_entry_finalizes_broadcast_mhc_weights` — the broadcast weight equals the hc-sum of the full matrix. - `test_kv_insert_fused_norm_row_strided` — the fused-norm insert against a torch RMSNorm + rope + quantize reference, parametrized over token counts, block sizes and row widths. - `test_v41_dspark_loads_linear_scales` extended: WKV scales also load into the merged projection as shard 0. ## End-to-end numbers Pending: campaign dsv41-pd-prologue-ab-001-20261025-1642 (8xH200 PD, same deployment, overlay and request mix as the campaigns on #63308; ctl = the five-PR stack, exp = this PR) is running, with gsm8k as the accuracy gate for the fused kv_norm. The expected e2e effect (~35 us on a 5-10 ms ITL) sits below the +-2% same-build repeat band of this deployment, so those tables will be reported as within noise unless they move outside it; the kernel-level prologue timing from the same trace window is the primary evidence for this PR. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) --- Need help on this PR? +def test_kv_insert_fused_norm_row_strided(
+    num_tokens: int, block_size: int, row_width: int
+):
+    """The KV-only insert with ``kv_norm_weight`` matches RMSNorm followed by
+    the unfused insert, reading a row-strided kv (the layer's half of a merged
+    multi-layer projection output)."""
+    torch.manual_seed(3)
+    device = "cuda"
+    dtype = torch.bfloat16
+    eps = 1e-6
+    max_pos = 4096

+    kv_buf = torch.randn(num_tokens, row_width, dtype=dtype, device=device)
+    kv = kv_buf[:, :HEAD_DIM]
+    norm_weight = torch.randn(HEAD_DIM, dtype=dtype, device=device)

+    num_blocks = (num_tokens + block_size - 1) // block_size + 1
+    slot_mapping = torch.arange(num_tokens, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+
+    # Reference: RMSNorm in vLLM's fp32 math, rope, then the Triton encoder.
+    xf = kv.float()
+    inv_rms = torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
+    normed = (xf * inv_rms * norm_weight.float()).to(dtype)
+    kv_ref = apply_rope_gptj_last_k(normed, positions, cos_sin_cache)
+    k_cache_ref = torch.zeros(
+        num_blocks, block_size * HEAD_BYTES, dtype=torch.uint8, device=device

+        kv_ref, k_cache_ref, slot_mapping, block_size=block_size, use_fnuz=USE_FNUZ

+        k_cache_fused,
+        slot_mapping,
+        positions,
+        cos_sin_cache,

+    # different orders, so a value can land one bf16 ULP off the reference and
